supporting_pages.title: "Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) overview \_|\_ Spanner \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Spanner is able to access the key on your behalf after you grant the Cloud KMS CryptoKey Encrypter/Decrypter ( roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter ) role to a Google-managed Spanner service account .
Service agents that use the keys for encrypt and decrypt operations are created if they don't already exist and are granted the required Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles.

evidence_snippets: Roles required to select or create a project Select a project : Selecting a project doesn't require a specific IAM role—you can select any project that you've been granted a role on.
